title: Built-in Copilot Cloud Agent Security Controls
summary: Select and configure agent tools, set up MCP servers with registries and allow lists, integrate agents into CI, and implement safe execution with robust error handling.

items: **Write access gate:** Only users WITH write access can trigger the agent via @copilot
**Branch isolation:** Agent pushes only to copilot/ branch — never to main
**No self-approval:** Agent CANNOT mark its own PRs as "Ready for review"
**No self-merge:** Draft PRs MUST be merged by a human
**Workflow approval gate:** Actions don't auto-run until write-access user approves
**Firewall:** Internet access restricted to prevent data exfiltration
**Signed commits:** All agent commits are cryptographically signed ("Verified" badge)
**Co-author attribution:** Developer who initiated is always co-author
**Prompt injection filter:** Hidden characters filtered from input before reaching agent
**Auto security scans:** CodeQL + Advisory DB + Secret scanning on all generated code

blocks.text: **Exam Trap:** "Auto-merging its own PRs" may appear as a listed mitigation. It is NOT — it's a risk that GitHub explicitly prevents.
